name: British Museum
description: The British Museum in London is renowned for its extensive collection of over 8 million artifacts spanning human history, including the Rosetta Stone, the Elgin Marbles, and Egyptian mummies. It is a leading institution for cultural heritage and archaeological research, with free public admission.

name: Tower of London
description: The Tower of London is a historic fortress and former royal palace on the River Thames, renowned for housing the Crown Jewels and its role as a medieval prison. Key attractions include the White Tower, medieval armory, and guided tours by Yeoman Warders. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site with over 1,000 years of history.

name: Buckingham Palace
description: Buckingham Palace is the official London residence and administrative headquarters of the British monarch, renowned for its iconic façade, the Changing of the Guard ceremony, and the State Rooms open to the public during summer. It serves as a central venue for royal events and ceremonies.

name: Westminster Abbey
description: Westminster Abbey is a historic Gothic church in London renowned for its architectural grandeur and as the traditional coronation and burial site of British monarchs. It houses numerous royal tombs, memorials, and the Poet's Corner, making it a significant cultural and historical landmark.

name: Big Ben & Houses of Parliament
description: Big Ben & the Houses of Parliament in London are iconic landmarks featuring the Elizabeth Tower, home to the famous Big Ben bell, and the historic Palace of Westminster, which houses the UK Parliament. Renowned for its Gothic Revival architecture and political significance, the site offers guided tours showcasing British legislative history.
